text:
jamie: quick heads-up — need a short sync on how we represent 'deprecated but still pinned' model variants in the rollout/pin metadata. current pin schema only has expiry, no deprecation phases.
maria: are we differentiating session-pins (user sessions) vs tenant-defaults? examples would help.
zach: yes — imagine v1.4 is pinned in active sessions while we send new traffic to v2. we need a way to express a coexistence window + fallback.
nora: tradeoff: more states = more client complexity. alt is server-side only "deprecation" flag + server routing heuristics, clients get a hint.
alex: rough proposal for schema fields (optional additions):
- deprecation_phase: one of ["active", "deprecated", "retired"]
- coexist_window: seconds (how long to honour pins vs default routing)
- fallback_alias: model id to route to when pin expires or is rejected
- client_enforced: boolean (if true, clients must respect pin even after deprecation)

jamie: concrete example payload for a pinned model: 
```json
{
  "model_id": "redwood/llama-13b-v2",
  "pin": true,
  "deprecation_phase": "deprecated",
  "coexist_window": 2592000,
  "fallback_alias": "redwood/llama-13b-v1",
  "client_enforced": false
}
```
maria: couple of questions: what about model variants / quantized builds? we need variant constraints in pins (eg "quant=8bit", "cuda11"). also how do we surface this in the UI/console?
zach: agree. add an optional field e.g. "variant_constraints": ["quant=8bit", "arch=sm75"]. and another set of server-only rollout knobs: "canary_pct", "rollout_tier" so we can shape traffic without breaking pinned sessions.
nora: ops implications: when backend nodes don't have fallback variant available, we need an automatic downgrade route or explicit failure. prefer explicit failure + observability.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: note — schema additive changes are fine, but we must version the control-plane API (v2) and add server-side validation so old components don't silently drop fields. recommend a compatibility header in requests. :hammer_and_wrench:
jamie: proposed action items: 1) add a schema draft to model-rollout repo (optional fields listed), 2) migration script to backfill "deprecation_phase":"active" for existing pins, 3) RFC follow-up to decide semantics for "client_enforced":true (safety/security review), 4) UI mock for variant constraints. i'll put PR up by EOD. :+1: 
maria: sounds good — ping me on the PR, i'll add UI notes.
zach: i'll sketch server routing pseudo code after lunch.
nora: i'll write the ops runbook snippet for fallback failure modes.
jamie: thanks all — keeping this tight so rollout behavior is deterministic for customers.
